workarounds.symptom: Internal p2p gRPC (port 6335) has no keepalive: idle pooled connections die silently behind stateful network layers, causing 62 s request stalls
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Enable HTTP/2 keepalive on internal p2p gRPC (port 6335). Target files: lib/api/src/grpc/dynamic_channel_pool.rs, lib/api/src/grpc/transport_channel_pool.rs, src/consensus.rs. - Enable HTTP/2 PING and TCP keepalive on internal p2p gRPC client channels and the internal server (port 6335), so idle pooled connections stay alive behind stateful network layers (Calico eBPF, NAT, load balancers) and dead/ghost connections are detected within ~10s instead of stalling requests for ~62s. - Defaults: `keepalive_interval_ms: 30000`, `ke... (Ref: https://github.com/qdrant/qdrant/pull/11273)

workarounds.symptom: qdrant-edge: EdgeShard never acknowledges its WAL, so wal/ grows with every update
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [AI] fix(edge): acknowledge the persisted version in EdgeShard::flush. Target files: lib/edge/src/edge_shard/mod.rs, lib/edge/tests/wal_options.rs. `EdgeShard::flush` writes every operation to its WAL and flushes the segments, but never acknowledges the persisted version. The WAL's `prefix_truncate` runs only when the application calls `ack`, so closed segments are never released and the `wal/` directory only ever grows. The reporter in #11068 measured 160 MiB of WAL on Windows for a single shard across four closed segments p... (Ref: https://github.com/qdrant/qdrant/pull/11082)

workarounds.symptom: Qdrant MMR applies limit before offset and returns too few points
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix MMR pagination with offsets (rebase of #10502 onto dev). Target files: lib/collection/src/collection/query.rs, lib/shard/src/query/mmr/mod.rs, lib/collection/tests/integration/collection_test.rs. Rebase of #10502 onto `dev`. Same two commits, cherry-picked with `-x`, original authorship preserved. (Ref: https://github.com/qdrant/qdrant/pull/10567)

workarounds.symptom: On-disk numeric index range checks silently swallow mmap read errors
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(segment): propagate mmap read errors from numeric index check_values_any. Target files: lib/segment/benches/numeric_index_check_values.rs, lib/segment/src/index/field_index/numeric_index/immutable_numeric_index/read_ops.rs, lib/segment/src/index/field_index/numeric_index/lifecycle.rs. On-disk numeric range checks silently swallowed mmap read errors: `NumericIndexRead::check_values_any` returned a bare `bool` and the on-disk impl ended with `.unwrap_or(false)`, so a failed mmap read was downgraded to "point does not match"... (Ref: https://github.com/qdrant/qdrant/pull/10181)
